caption: The drawing depicts a single wooden chair with a curved backrest and four splayed legs. The wood frame of the chair is a reddish-brown color, and the seat is upholstered in a green fabric. The backrest features a horizontal slat at the top and a decorative central element connected by two curved, X-shaped wooden supports. The chair is positioned angled slightly to the left, and the background is plain in a light beige or off-white tone, with a thin rectangular border framing the image. The artist's signature, "F. Alvarez," is visible in the lower left corner of the drawing.
title: Side Chair
